北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京有霾，出门记得戴口罩，保护呼吸道哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is hazy. Remember to wear a mask outdoors to protect your respiratory system!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪有雾，能见度低，开车请慢行，注意安全。
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is foggy with low visibility. Drive slowly and stay safe.

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海多云，气温适宜。享受这美好的天气吧！
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is cloudy with pleasant temperatures. Enjoy this lovely weather!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州阴天，湿度高。记得多喝水，保持身体舒适。
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is overcast with high humidity. Remember to drink more water to stay comfortable.

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳多云，气温舒适。是散步的好时光。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is cloudy with comfortable temperatures. It's a great time for a walk.

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州多云，体感 18℃。出门穿件薄外套哦。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is cloudy with a feels like 18℃. Grab a light jacket when you go out.

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京晴朗，阳光正好。享受户外的美好时光！
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is sunny and bright. Enjoy the wonderful time outdoors!

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都湿度高达 99%，感觉潮湿。注意防潮哦。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu's humidity is 99%, feeling damp. Remember to take precautions against moisture.

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉阴天，气温适中。保持好心情，轻松出行。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is overcast with moderate temperatures. Keep a good mood and travel easily.

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安阴天，体感 12℃。记得多穿衣，别着凉啦。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is overcast with a feels like 12℃. Remember to dress warmly to avoid catching a cold.

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆有雾，湿度大。出行注意安全，早晚添衣。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is foggy with high humidity. Be safe when traveling and add layers in the morning/evening.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨有霾且体感 3℃，风力 4级。注意防风保暖哦！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is hazy with a feels like 3℃ and 4-level wind. Remember to protect from wind and stay warm!

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳多云，气温 10℃。早晚温差大，注意保暖。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is cloudy with 10℃. Large temperature swings between morning/evening, dress warmly.

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明阴天，体感 9℃。穿件暖和的衣服，别感冒了。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is overcast with a feels like 9℃. Wear warm clothes to avoid catching a cold.

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门有雾，湿度较高。出行请小心，注意安全。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is foggy with high humidity. Please be careful when traveling and stay safe.

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛阴天，体感 9℃，风力 3级。多穿衣，注意防风。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is overcast with a feels like 9℃ and 3-level wind. Dress warmly and protect from wind.

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连有霾且体感 9℃，风力 3级。出门注意防护保暖。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is hazy with a feels like 9℃ and 3-level wind. Remember to protect and stay warm outdoors.
